categoryDefinitions.H: Historical-only solidarity in the evidence collected

limitations: The index is not a complete worldwide census.
An organizer attribution is not independent authentication of every signature or identity.
Registers overlap and include entries other than individual musicians.
Absence does not establish silence or any political position.
Imported artist tier is a legacy strongest-category summary; preserve individual evidence types.
Review source support, identities, campaign associations, quotations and dates before publication.
Research snapshot date is not the date of a statement or a new source review.
Do not automatically merge normalized names or infer positions of band members or label artists.

campaigns.name: No Music for Genocide
campaigns.description: An artist boycott collective that published a roster of musicians boycotting the cycle of music industry complicity in the genocide of Palestinians.

campaigns.name: Musicians for Palestine (2023)
campaigns.description: An open letter published in late 2023, signed by thousands of musicians, describing Gaza as a "textbook case of genocide" and demanding a ceasefire.

campaigns.name: Eurovision boycott (2026)
campaigns.description: A campaign calling for the boycott of Eurovision 2026 over the participation of Israel, organized through No Music for Genocide.

campaigns.name: Artists4Ceasefire
campaigns.description: A public supporter list of artists advocating for a ceasefire and Palestinian rights.
